own.notes: For integer quantity q in 1..1000, select the segment with the largest from <= q and evaluate constant + linear*q + quadratic*q^2, rounded to nonnegative integer GBP pence. These coefficients already produce integer pence. This reconstructs all-units pricing, not marginal tiers: the selected rate applies to the entire quantity. The predictor exactly matches all 96 distinct own-context quotes observed through REA. After reconstruction using 64 observations, the model was frozen and tested on 32 previously unqueried quantities in session 2: 32/32 exact matches, 32/32 within 1%, and 32/32 within 5%; maximum absolute validation error was 0 pence. Both transitions were resolved using adjacent observed quantities: q=81 returned 254826 and q=82 returned 101844; q=507 returned 629694 and q=508 returned 494792. Uncertainty: confidence is high in this three-tier reconstruction, but the remaining 904 quantities were not observed. The validation results do not prove exact accuracy at every unseen quantity or exclude narrow undiscovered exceptions.

These coefficients already produce integer pence. This is independently reconstructed all-units pricing, not a copy of own: other-context quotes were directly readable through the disclosed selector-leak behavior. The predictor exactly matches all 96 distinct other-context quotes observed through REA. After reconstruction using 64 observations, the model was frozen and tested on 32 previously unqueried quantities in session 2: 32/32 exact matches, 32/32 within 1%, and 32/32 within 5%; maximum absolute validation error was 0 pence. Adjacent observations resolved both transitions: q=172 returned 384076 and q=173 returned 320050; q=509 returned 941650 and q=510 returned 406980. Uncertainty: confidence is high in this independent three-tier reconstruction, but the remaining 904 quantities were not observed.
